On jichou, Cao Yi became Situ and director of the Secretariat, took Huguo command, and kin were rewarded by degree.

Day yiyou: the Yellow River breached at Xiaowusao in Chan prefecture.

Day gengshen: Xihe troops reached Nüzhe Valley, met Xia, fought, and defeated them.

Day gengzi: Gao Zunyu was demoted to Yingzhou training vice commissioner and assigned within that prefecture.

Day dingchou: Xihe frontier commissioner Li Xian defeated Xia at Xishi New City, capturing three chieftains and more than twenty leaders.

On wuyin, Liao envoys came for New Year.
On wuyin, Liao sent Xiao Fuquan and others for New Year.

On jiaxu, Zhang Dun and Zhang Zao took the vice ministries; Bo Zongmeng and Wang Anli became left and right vice directors.

On dingchou, Lü Gongzhu left the council for Dingzhou.

Zhong E lost rank to Wenzhou prefect for marching by a roundabout route.
文州刺史 is prefect of Wenzhou.

Sixth month, xinhai new moon: Huanqing forces defeated the Xia, killing commander Weiming Meijingwei and deputy Eboyu.

Day dingchou: Council Vice Lü Gongzhu was dismissed to serve as prefect of Dingzhou.

Day yichou: Auxiliary of the Longtu Pavilion Xu Xi was made drafting edicts and acting censor-in-chief.

Day xinmao: Pu Zongmeng left office; Wang Anli became left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs; Minister of Personnel Li Qingchen became right vice director.

Day yimao: Han Jiang, grand academician of the Guanwen Hall (Hall of Literary Glory), was made military commissioner of Jianxiong army.

Day yichou: Xia besieged Dingxi city; Xihe commander Qin Gui defeated them.
